<!--
PLEASE NOTE: We do not accept AI-only PRs - they will be closed.

We expect the following:
* A human-written (and easily human-readable) summary which is succinct
and explains the PR. If you're copy-pasting AI output, you're doing it wrong.
* All AI-generated content must be explicitly labelled as such.
* The summary and tasks sections below must be kept and filled out as required.
* Automatic AI generated comments to the PR be disabled.

We expect authors to have fully reviewed any AI-generated code line by
line to ensure correctness. Furthermore, we expect authors to have thought
through any submitted code to ensure it's fit for purpose, which may include
consideration of things like memory-efficiency, performance and the bigger picture
of how it will affect end users.

If you meet these criteria, please create a draft PR initially,
and change it to a regular PR when you consider it ready for final review.

Failure to abide by the spirit of these guidelines will result in the PR being closed.
-->

#### Summary
Non-AI-generated paragraph **succinctly** explaining what bug fix or enhancement the PR
addresses.  Include the related pydicom issue number(s) if any exist.

#### Further details
If necessary, more details about the rationale or technical aspects of the changes.
Long AI-generated details will be rejected unless reduced to reasonable
human-readable levels.

#### Tasks
- [ ] Author has created all code and/or has reviewed AI-generated code line by line
- [ ] Unit tests added that reproduce the issue or prove feature is working
- [ ] Fix or feature added
- [ ] Code typed and mypy shows no errors
- [ ] Documentation updated (if relevant)
  - [ ] No warnings during build
  - [ ] Preview link (CircleCI -> Artifacts -> `doc/_build/html/index.html`)
- [ ] Unit tests passing and overall coverage the same or better
